We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Head of Finance (m/f/d) Your Role

As Head of Finance, you own the entire finance operation behind one of Europe's fastest-growing companies, across our entities in Europe and the US.

 * Own accounting for all entities: pre-accounting in-house, full ownership of our accounting stack, and the transition to fully in-house accounting in 2027.

 * Run controlling: month-end, quarterly and annual closings, revenue reporting down to the invoice line item, cost and profit center reporting.

 * Own tax: VAT and sales tax, employment tax and contributions, international tax, and transfer pricing between entities.

 * Own cash flow and treasury: planning, forecasting, cash reserves, return optimization, intercompany transfers and FX.

 * Roll out a lean ERP and turn everything manual in finance into workflows and AI agents.

 * Build and lead the finance team, starting with your first hire shortly after you join.

 * Work directly with both founders and the extended leadership team.

What We Offer

 * Up to €130,000 + equity package.

 * On-site in Vienna, relocation package if needed.

 * Real ownership from day one

 * Everything you need to be successful. If you need it, you get it.

What You Bring

 * You were part of building a finance in a fast-growing company, internationally, across different jurisdictions and accounting regulations. (ideally: VC-backed B2B SaaS/Tech)

 * You have run closings and accounting prep yourself, not just reviewed them.

 * You are experienced across controlling, tax, cash flow and treasury.

 * Workflows, agents and automations are your default, not the exception. Claude Code, n8n and similar tools are part of your toolkit.

 * Obsession with detail: small errors bother you before they bother anyone else.

 * Perfect German, very good English.

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro Call

 * 15 min Intro Call with our Chief of Staff

 * 45 min Skill Interview & Case Study Discussion

 * On-Site Meeting in Vienna

 * 20 min Culture Call with the founders

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it! 1 Product Manager - Construction & Real Estate (PropTech) (m/f/d) Job description
We're now looking for a Product Manager with experience in the construction industry to take our platform to the next level- owning the roadmap, pricing, and scope along the way. Not managing. Shaping.

Your mission

 * The roadmap across all product areas. You decide what ships next - and you stand behind the why.

 * The path from prototype to platform. You sequence the porting effort in waves, cut scope where it's needed, and keep the codebases together instead of letting them drift apart.

 * Pricing and packaging. You align packaging with sales, keep the unit economics of compute-intensive simulation runs healthy, and own the Stripe catalog end-to-end.

 * Discovery and delivery with customers. You run pilot projects, sit down with asset managers and engineers, translate what you hear into specs, and make sure the platform's reports and studies hold up with customers.

 * Quality standards for simulation results. Engineers have to trust the numbers. You define, per engine, what "good enough to ship" means, and you manage the trade-off between physical accuracy and product speed.

 * The written trail. PRDs, a well-maintained decision log, release notes. Our rule: if it isn't documented, it didn't happen.

Your profile

 * Product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment - with substantial time spent on a technical or data-intensive product.

 * Experience in - or hands-on exposure to - the construction industry.

 * An AI-native way of working: for you, AI is a tool, not a buzzword.

 * Real technical confidence. You question a data model, follow a discussion with engineers, and understand a simulation output well enough to challenge it.

 * A degree that connects building energy systems, simulation, and building operations across engineering disciplines - or equivalent hands-on competence in building analysis and simulation

 * Fluent English; professional German strongly preferred.

Why us?

 * Real impact. Your product decisions feed into real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - a complete product portfolio rather than isolated one-off projects.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option & a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000.00 - €80,000.00 gross/year.

jobs.description:
Mit A1 für morgen. Make it happen.

Was wir tun, tun wir mit Leidenschaft. Darum stellen wir Kund_innen smarte Technologie zur Verfügung, die vieles möglich macht. Wir arbeiten mit Verantwortung - sind dabei aber immer offen, neugierig und kreativ. Denn nur so ist man der Zeit einen Sprung voraus. 

Wir suchen 1 SOC Analyst with German (f/m/d) @ A1 Competence Delivery Center As a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting customer environments against cyber threats. You will monitor security events, investigate incidents, coordinate response activities and support customers in maintaining a strong security posture.

The role combines hands-on cybersecurity operations with incident investigation and customer-focused security support, providing exposure to diverse technologies, threat landscapes and international security environments.

Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Detection

Monitor customer environments for security threats, suspicious activities and policy violations, ensuring timely identification of potential risks.

Alert Analysis & Triage

Analyze and prioritize security alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, cloud and other security technologies, determining appropriate response actions.

Incident Investigation

Investigate security incidents, assess their severity, impact and business relevance, and distinguish between true positive and false positive events.

Incident Escalation & Response Support

Escalate validated incidents to customer security teams in accordance with established procedures and SLAs, while supporting incident response activities when required.

Customer Communication

Communicate incident details, recommendations and investigation findings to customers in a clear, professional and customer-oriented manner.

Threat Analysis & Correlation

Correlate information from multiple data sources to identify malicious activity, emerging threats and attack patterns across complex environments.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Document investigations, findings and response actions within ticketing and case management systems, while contributing to threat hunting, detection improvements and SOC process optimization.

Collaboration & Security Enhancement

Work closely with international colleagues, customers and technology partners to strengthen overall security capabilities and improve customer security posture.

Your Profile

 * Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services, Incident Response or a similar cybersecurity role

 * Good understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and incident handling processes

 * Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar or similar technologies

 * Familiarity with EDR/XDR solutions, Microsoft Defender, network security monitoring and cloud security services

 * Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess and prioritize security events effectively

 * Experience working in a customer-facing environment and communicating technical findings to various audiences

 * Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple incidents and maintain attention to detail

 * German language proficiency at C1 level or native speaker (mandatory)

 * Strong English communication skills
